'''Chupe andino''' refers to various [[stew]]s and [[soup]]s that are prepared in the [[Andes]] mountains region in South America.<ref name="Palomino Gargagliano Cushner 2002"/><ref name="Venezuela Tuya 2015"/> ''Chupe Andino'' may be prepared by [[Andean Peoples|Andean people]], those that live in the region.<ref name="Venezuela Tuya 2015"/> It is sometimes prepared in large portions to feed many people at marketplaces and events.<ref name="Trome 2014"/><ref name="Generaccion.com"/> ''Chupe Andino'' is sometimes served with wine as an accompaniment.<ref name="Palomino Gargagliano Cushner 2002"/><ref name="Venezuela Tuya 2015"/> Soups and stews play a significant part in Andean cuisine, because the cold weather in the region demands nutritious, fatty foods that are warming.<ref name="Venezuela Tuya 2015"/>

The term ''[[chupe]]'' is a standard South American term that refers to various stews prepared with meats,<ref name="Field and Stream"/> fish<ref name="ElPopular_pe 2013"/> and seafood, tripe and offal. Additional ingredients may include potato, onion, garlic and cheese.<ref name="ElPopular_pe 2013"/> In the past, it has been prepared using [[yuca]] as an ingredient.<ref name="Field and Stream"/>
